rows.text: It comprises three ambitions: to enable a low-carbon and circular economy, empower our people and communities, and embed responsible business practices throughout our organisation.
rows.source_sentence: It comprises three ambitions: to enable a low-carbon and circular economy, empower our people and communities, and embed responsible business practices throughout our organisation.

rows.text: In the spirit of sustainability, winners are encouraged to plant a tree or offered the option to procure carbon offsets to support climate change action.
rows.source_sentence: In the spirit of sustainability, winners are encouraged to plant a tree or offered the option to procure carbon offsets to support climate change action.

rows.text: Reducing our GHG emissions and moving towards a balanced portfolio of low-carbon energy assets.
rows.source_sentence: Reducing our GHG emissions and moving towards a balanced portfolio of low-carbon energy assets

rows.text: Making health and safety an integral part of our everyday business and culture.
rows.source_sentence: Making health and safety an integral part of our everyday business and culture

rows.text: Partner of Carbon Pricing Leadership Coalition Singapore.
rows.source_sentence: Partner of Carbon Pricing Leadership Coalition Singapore

rows.text: We aim to transform our portfolio towards a greener future, by focusing on growing our Renewables and Integrated Urban Solutions businesses.
rows.source_sentence: We aim to transform our portfolio towards a greener future, by focusing on growing our Renewables and Integrated Urban Solutions businesses

rows.text: We implemented several measures to ensure the safety of our employees.
rows.source_sentence: While we worked on keeping our operations intact, we also implemented several measures to ensure the safety of our employees

rows.text: Precautionary measures for employees remained in place to safeguard our employees’ health and safety.
rows.source_sentence: Precautionary measures for employees remained in place to safeguard our employees’ health and safety

rows.text: We have set targets to reduce GHG emissions intensity by 25% from 2020 baseline, to 0.40 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent per megawatt hour (tCO2e/MWh) by 2025.
rows.source_sentence: We have set targets to: • Reduce GHG emissions intensity by 25% from 2020 baseline, to 0.40 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent per megawatt hour (tCO2e/MWh) by 2025

rows.text: We have set targets to reduce absolute GHG emissions (Scope 1 and 2) by 90% from 2020 baseline to 2.7 million tCO2e by 2030.
rows.source_sentence: • Reduce absolute GHG emissions (Scope 1 and 2) by 90% from 2020 baseline to 2.7 million tCO2e by 2030

rows.text: Our GHG emissions intensity was 0.51tCO2e/MWh compared to 0.54tCO2e/MWh in 2020.
rows.source_sentence: Our GHG emissions intensity was 0.51tCO2e/MWh compared to 0.54tCO2e/MWh in 2020.

rows.text: Our gross installed renewable energy capacity comprising wind, solar and energy storage assets grew slightly from 2.6 gigawatt (GW) in 2020 to over 2.7GW.
rows.source_sentence: Our gross installed renewable energy capacity comprising wind, solar and energy storage assets grew slightly from 2.6 gigawatt (GW) in 2020 to over 2.7GW.

rows.text: The nature of our business means that any lapse in health or safety protocols may result in direct or indirect impact on our employees, contractors, customers and communities.
rows.source_sentence: The nature of our business means that any lapse in health or safety protocols may result in direct or indirect impact on our employees, contractors, customers and communities.

rows.text: We recognise the right to life, health and safe working conditions, and are committed to reducing health and safety risks in our operations.
rows.source_sentence: We recognise the right to life, health and safe working conditions, and are committed to reducing health and safety risks in our operations.

rows.text: We also require our contractors to comply with our health and safety requirements to prevent and manage health and safety risks.
rows.source_sentence: We also require our contractors to comply with our health and safety requirements to prevent and manage health and safety risks.

rows.text: Occupational health and safety falls under the oversight of the Group HSSE division, who provides updates to the board’s Risk Committee.
rows.source_sentence: Occupational health and safety falls under the oversight of the Group HSSE division, who provides updates to the board’s Risk Committee.

rows.text: Performance incentives for all employees take into account the Group’s overall health and safety performance for the year.
rows.source_sentence: Performance incentives for all employees take into account the Group’s overall health and safety performance for the year.

rows.text: Product safety and reliability are overseen by the chief executive officers of various markets, who are bound by regulatory and contractual terms to meet product and service specifications and standards.
rows.source_sentence: Product safety and reliability are overseen by the chief executive officers of various markets, who are bound by regulatory and contractual terms to meet product and service specifications and standards.

rows.text: There was an increase in both our lost time injury rate and total recordable injury rate since 2020.
rows.source_sentence: There was an increase in both our lost time injury rate and total recordable injury rate since 2020.

rows.text: To further cultivate an engaged workforce, we transitioned our performance review model to a continuous performance management model, to drive a culture of continuous conversations.
rows.source_sentence: To further cultivate an engaged workforce, we transitioned our performance review model to a continuous performance management model, to drive a culture of continuous conversations.

rows.text: The Group Integrated Audit division provides independent assurance to the senior leadership council and the board’s Audit Committee on the reliability, adequacy and effectiveness of our internal controls system, risk management, governance framework and processes.
rows.source_sentence: The Group Integrated Audit division provides independent assurance to the senior leadership council and the board’s Audit Committee on the reliability, adequacy and effectiveness of our internal controls system, risk management, governance framework and processes.

rows.text: The global energy transition towards decarbonisation has led to significant risks and business model disruptions.
